subject: Aligning renewal cadence + burst window for upcoming Q1 surge
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.b@cloudpark.com>, Procurement Team <procurements@cloudpark.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning renewal cadence + burst window for upcoming Q1 surge

Hi Evelyn / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week — great to hear CloudPark's Q1 roadmap (data indexing + realtime search) is driving a concentrated burst of inference in Jan–Mar. I put together a short proposal to align the renewal cadence with your budgeting and to add a temporary burst capacity window to handle the expected spike without long-term overcommit.

High-level proposal:
- Term: 18 months starting 2026-01-01 to align with your fiscal year and give you a mid-term check-in in H2 2026.
- Ramp schedule: base committed capacity of 200k token-seconds/month for months 1–6, then linear ramp to 400k token-seconds/month by month 12.
- Burst window: a 90-day burst credit pool (up to 2.5x base throughput) available Jan–Mar 2026; unused burst credits do not roll over.
- Auto-renew: option to enable auto-renew at the 18-month mark with 60-day advance notice; default is opt-out.
- Pricing: I attached a redline SOW with two pricing bands (standard vs. burst credits).

Next steps I suggest:
1) I can send a redlined SOW + usage export for your finance/procurement to validate baseline usage.
2) If that looks good, sign-off on burst window and we route to Legal for a short amendment.

CCing Monica from CS to confirm onboarding/ops tasks and to coordinate runbook updates.

Would you like me to send the SOW and the Oct usage export to procurement now?

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0189

---
Attachment: CloudPark_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft, 4 pages)
Attachment: CloudPark_usage_Oct2025.csv (export of monthly token consumption)
From: Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.b@cloudpark.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurements@cloudpark.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@cloudpark.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning renewal cadence + burst window for upcoming Q1 surge

Diego —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick questions from my side and procurement: 

- Can you confirm whether unused burst credits are refundable or strictly non-refundable?
- For the ramp, can we front-load a slightly higher base for months 1–3 (we expect heavy indexing in month 1) and then step down?
- Procurement will need a clear list of deliverables tied to the SOW (audit logs, onboarding checklist, runbook handoff).

If you can send the usage export and the SOW, we’ll review internally and aim to get feedback by end of next week.

Thanks — Evelyn
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudPark
Evelyn.B@cloudpark.com

Subject: Re: Aligning renewal cadence + burst window for upcoming Q1 surge

Evelyn —

Thanks — quick answers inline and attached the usage export you requested.

- Burst credits: non-refundable, but we can convert up to 20% of unused burst credits into one-time consumption credits for a subsequent quarter (requires election within 30 days after burst window closes).
- Front-loading: yes — we can reconfigure the ramp to 300k token-seconds/month for months 1–3, then stabilize to 220k for months 4–6 and resume the original linear ramp to 400k by month 12. That preserves overall committed volume while giving you headroom early.
- Deliverables: included in page 2 of the attached SOW — onboarding checklist, runbook handoff, 3x 90-minute runbook workshops, and audit-log export format. Monica: please confirm we can commit to the three runbook workshops.

Attaching: CloudPark_usage_Oct2025.csv and CloudPark_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with deliverables and front-loaded ramp redline).

Let me know if you want a short sync next week to walk procurement through the SOW.

Best,
Diego

Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Aligning renewal cadence + burst window for upcoming Q1 surge — pricing guidance

Diego / Rishi —

Looping you in for pricing approval. Evelyn asked about front-loading months 1–3 and wants clarity on refunds/credits for unused burst. Diego has proposed a conversion of up to 20% unused burst into one-time consumption credits.

Quick context: baseline usage from Oct (attached) shows a monthly average of ~180k token-seconds; proposed base commits would increase spend but give them guaranteed capacity for mission-critical indexing.

Ask: can we offer a one-time 15% discount on committed units for the first 6 months if they sign the 18-month term and accept the non-refundable burst credit policy? This helps close and offsets their short-term budget pressure.

Rishi — any objections from a billing/finance perspective?

—Marissa

- Deal signs the 18-month SOW by 2025-12-10.
- Bursts remain non-refundable; conversion option (up to 20%) as Diego proposed is acceptable.
- Payment terms: Net 30; any delay beyond 45 days triggers suspension of burst access until caught up.

Monica — ensure the runbook workshops are scheduled and documented in the SOW as deliverables (they are a dependency for enabling burst ops).

Rishi

Subject: Updated SOW + DocuSign (burst window + 18-month term)

Evelyn / Procurement —

Thanks for the questions and patience. Per internal approvals, we can offer the following if CloudPark signs the SOW by 2025-12-10:

- 18-month term starting 2026-01-01 (as proposed).
- One-time 15% discount on committed units for months 1–6.
- Front-loaded months 1–3 at 300k token-seconds/month, then 220k months 4–6, ramp to 400k by month 12.
- Burst: 90-day Jan–Mar 2026 pool, non-refundable; up to 20% of unused burst credits convertible to one-time consumption credit (election within 30 days after window).
- Deliverables: onboarding checklist, runbook handoff, three 90-minute runbook workshops (Monica will coordinate dates), audit-log export format included.

I’ve attached the updated SOW and opened a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-123-CP-SOW

If procurement wants a short review call, I’m available next week Tue/Thu morning PST. Otherwise, please sign and we’ll schedule Monica’s team for the workshops and a pre-burst ops dry-run.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
